UDP/IP Addresses - Nasdaq Data Feeds

  • All
  • U.S. Equities
  • U.S. Derivatives
  • Bonds
  • Other Data

Overview


Nasdaq offers many of its direct data feed products in a UDP/IP protocol option. Please refer to Nasdaq Global Data Products - Direct Data Feeds page for product description and technical interface documentation for the U.S. based products.

As a service to network providers, Nasdaq maintains a consolidated list of IP addresses for its UDP/IP services. Please note that Nasdaq reserves the right to modify this IP address information as needed for network and operational reasons.

Products by Market

Nasdaq PHLX (PHLX):

  • PHLX Depth of Market
  • Top of PHLX Options (TOPO)
  • PHLX Orders

Nasdaq Options Market (NOM):

  • Nasdaq ITCH to Trade Options (ITTO)
  • Best of Nasdaq Options (BONO)

Nasdaq BX Options (BX Options):

  • BX Options Depth of Market 2.0 (BX Depth)
  • BX Options Top of Market 2.0 (BX Top)

Nasdaq GEMX (GEMX):

  • Nasdaq GEMX Top Quote Feed
  • Nasdaq GEMX Depth of Market Feed
  • Nasdaq GEMX Order Feed
  • Nasdaq GEMX Trade Feed

Nasdaq ISE (ISE):

  • Nasdaq ISE Top Quote Feed
  • Nasdaq ISE Depth Feed
  • Nasdaq ISE Order Feed
  • Nasdaq ISE Spread Feed
  • Nasdaq ISE Trade Feed

Nasdaq MRX (MRX):

  • Nasdaq MRX Top of Market Feed 2.01
  • Nasdaq MRX Depth of Market Feed 2.01
  • Nasdaq MRX Order Feed 2.01
  • Nasdaq MRX Spread Feed 2.01
  • Nasdaq MRX Trade Feed 2.01
